propositions: When a child's direct parent is type-collapsed (non-epic in an epic-only project), the outbound parent field is suppressed but the child lacks visible context pointing to its nearest represented ancestor.

An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be appended to the child in Jira, naming the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key and decorated with both RECONCILER_MARKER and a stable identity tag to prevent re-ingestion and duplicates.

The breadcrumb is emitted from the outbound comment differ (_diff_comments), not from scalar-only apply-time recording, using new local_parents and local_ticket_types parameters and a walk up the ancestor chain via binding_store.
Dedup on stable tag <!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb --> ensures append-once idempotency across passes, even when the nearest represented ancestor changes.
If one or more intervening ancestors lack bound keys, the breadcrumb body explicitly states this before naming the nearest bound ancestor.
No breadcrumb is emitted when no bound ancestor exists, when the parent type is epic, or when the parent is absent from the ticket map.
